open_points.subject: MCP action surface (K-11 and Primary actions)
open_points.text: “The kernel exposes one fixed set of typed operations over `mcp`: inspect, author, try, run, resume, read traces, and the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel.” This list omits the separately required actions “capture a failed execution”, “release a failed run”, “roll a slot back”, “propose an operation binding”, and “compose and prove a flow”.
open_points.question: Are the omitted primary actions exposed over MCP, and if so are they distinct operations or sub-actions of one of the listed operations?
options: Expose every primary action as a distinct typed MCP operation
Treat the omitted actions as explicitly defined sub-actions of listed operations
Do not expose the omitted actions over MCP
open_points.default_guess: Expose every primary action as a distinct typed MCP operation.

open_points.subject: Flow activation action
open_points.text: K-11 groups `activate` among “the owner's” operations, while the primary-action table and K-08 say an agent may ask to activate a proven read-only version and the kernel activates it.
open_points.question: May an agent invoke the flow-activation action for a proven read-only version?
options: Yes, agents and the owner may request read-only activation; only the owner may request effectful activation
No, only the owner may invoke activation
Agents may request activation of every proven version
open_points.default_guess: Allow agents and the owner to request read-only activation, and require the owner for effectful activation.

open_points.subject: FlowVersion and FlowConstant (K-07, M13, M16)
open_points.text: K-07 says a flow has “three structural forms: an edge, a map of a node over a collection, and a guard on a declared closed value,” while M13 includes `constants` and M16 defines a FlowConstant delivered directly to a node input.
open_points.question: Are constants a permitted fourth flow construct, a kind of one of the three stated forms, or not part of flows?
options: Permit FlowConstant as a fourth construct
Define FlowConstant as a special edge source within the existing edge form
Remove FlowConstant and require such values to arrive through flow inputs or nodes
open_points.default_guess: Permit FlowConstant explicitly as a fourth flow construct.

open_points.subject: Activation after trial-corpus growth (M06, M08, M09)
open_points.text: An activation requires an `admitted` verdict over the current corpus, but trial cases can be added or captured after activation, the corpus only grows, and M09 says the current activation is simply the activation recorded last.
open_points.question: What happens to a contract version's current activation when its trial corpus grows and the activated implementation has no admitted verdict over the new corpus?
options: The activation record remains but is no longer usable, leaving the contract version without a runnable current implementation
The existing activation remains runnable until another admission or rollback replaces it
The kernel automatically readmits the activated implementation against the enlarged corpus and keeps or invalidates it from that result
open_points.default_guess: Keep the historical activation record but make it unusable until an implementation is admitted over the enlarged corpus and activated.

open_points.subject: ProofResult identity (M17)
open_points.text: M17 says “proving the same version gives the same result,” but proof depends on mutable binding status, and the carried State 2 decision says a version that failed because a binding was not accepted can be proven again later and succeed.
open_points.question: What identifies a ProofResult when the same flow version can produce different proof results at different times?
options: It is an ephemeral value identified by all result facts, so one flow version may yield different ProofResult values
Its identity includes a snapshot or digest of every mutable proof dependency
It is one entity per proof execution with a kernel-minted identity
A flow version has one frozen proof result and must be versioned again after dependencies change
open_points.default_guess: Treat each computed result as an ephemeral value identified by its full facts; do not assert that a flow version always has one result.
